Name: Marnie Edit
Author: pipmimi
Description:
It always bothered me that Marnie looked different to all the other sprites with her huge face and permanent smile.
I've removed the smile and tried to make her face fit with the style of the others.

Now includes Marnie's beach and winter sprites (includes CP version)

To install:
Unzip the folder,
Then simply drag and drop into: Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Content/Characters
(Don't forget to make a back-up just incase you change your mind!)

If you like this edit check out my ones for Gus and Pam - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3050]Gus Edit[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3051/]Pam Edit[/url]
